summary: The task failed because the agent rounded values to 2 decimal places, violating the skill's explicit 'NO ROUNDING' rule. The verifier expects full-precision floats. Additionally, the cardiology panel introduces new analytes (BNP, NT_proBNP, Troponin_I, Troponin_T) not covered in the existing skill. This patch adds cardiology-specific conversion factors and strengthens the anti-rounding guidance with explicit examples of the failure mode seen in the trace.
